name: Fresh Trails — Red + Yellow = Orange
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied square Blend Trails casual game icon. Recolor ONLY the game paths and mixed-color target cells. Preserve the exact original composition, every tile position, curve shape, endpoint size, outline thickness, crop, lighting, shadows, highlights and blue radial background.
Required color substitutions:
1. Repaint the entire cobalt BLUE GAME PATH to vivid warm coral RED (#FF343E): the upper-left circular endpoint and its rightward/downward route, and the lower-right circular endpoint and its leftward route. Preserve the original navy contours and the same glossy cel-shaded highlights, adapting blue highlights to pale pink/cream and blue shadows on these path objects to darker red.
2. Repaint the central bright GREEN SHARED VERTICAL PATH to saturated warm ORANGE (#FF8B08), representing RED + YELLOW = ORANGE. Include the complete shared vertical segment, both curved boundaries, its shading and highlights.
3. Repaint BOTH central tiles' green target borders to orange, and their pale green interior tint to pale warm peach/cream, preserving all tile geometry.
4. Keep the existing YELLOW PATH and yellow circular endpoints exactly yellow and unchanged.
Critical invariants: keep the sky-blue background, light-cyan radial rays, cyan/navy offset shadows around the tile board, all dark navy outlines, and the four warm cream side tiles unchanged. Do not globally replace the background blue; only the foreground blue game path becomes red. No remaining green on the center path or target frames. No blue on foreground game paths.
Deliver the same single full-bleed square icon, no text, no new objects, no additional designs. The intended result is the SAME icon in RED + YELLOW = ORANGE colors.
